title: Project Learning Record
description: Schema for learnings/<codename>.yaml files. Rust agov is the current AGF v2 operator validator surface; historical v1.x Python validators are legacy reference material. Cross-artefact invariants (append-only supersession, confidence corroboration thresholds) live in schemas/invariants.yaml.

codename.description: Mandatory pseudonym, never the real project name. Anonymisation policy enforced separately by validate-infosec.

checkout_role.description: Optional. 'live' marks this record as the checkout's own, currently-maintained adoption state -- the version-drift check (agov.validate.learnings) only compares framework_version against agf/VERSION for 'live' records. 'imported' marks a reference copy of another adopter's (or historical) submission. Absence means unknown -- treated the same as 'imported' for the drift check (never asserts a live-version claim). Docs: agf/docs/site/docs/adopt/install-and-layouts.md, Step 7.

upgrade_in_progress.description: Optional. Set true by agf/skills/upgrade/SKILL.md Step 3 at the start of an upgrade, on the record identified by Step 0, before any archive file is copied. Cleared (field removed) by Step 4 immediately after framework_version is updated. Suppresses the version-drift check for this exact record while upgrade_started_at is within the bounded window.

upgrade_started_at.description: Optional. RFC3339 timestamp set alongside upgrade_in_progress. If more than 24 hours old, the version-drift check stops honoring the suppression and additionally emits a 'stale upgrade_in_progress marker' finding.

id.description: Stable learning identifier. Historical records may use L###; bare timestamp IDs may exist as historical references but new records use YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ-<4-char-random>. Preserve existing IDs when updating historical records.

category.description: Conventional values per learnings/_template.yaml: gap | overkill | validation | adaptation | tension. Rust agov validates the current AGF v2 learning record surface.

scope.description: Conventional values: framework | project. Validator does not currently enforce.

type.description: Conventional values across the corpus: prevented_loss | enabled_revenue | cost_overhead | neutral | positive. Validator does not enforce the enum.

severity.description: Conventional values: critical | significant | minor | informational. Validator does not enforce the enum.

superseded_by.description: Deprecated (Gate 1 approved 2026-08-03, docs/plans/learning-supersession-status-fields.md). Required editing the old entry after a later one existed, contradicting append-only operation, and was never enforced or populated. Not documented as the current mechanism and not validated. Use 'supersedes' on the new entry instead. Kept schema-legal pending a future governor factual determination on outright removal (Path A).

supersedes.description: Optional forward-only pointer, set on the new/superseding entry, to the id of the earlier entry it replaces. Never edits the superseded entry. Validated by validate_learnings: the referenced id must exist in the same file and must precede this entry's position. The reverse view (what superseded id X) is derived at read time, not stored. Pattern accepts the same three id forms 'id' itself accepts (L###, bare YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ, suffixed YYYYMMDDThhmmssZ-xxxx) so a bare-timestamp record already accepted by the corpus validator can be named as a supersession target (fixed 2026-08-03, B-LS-IMP-1).

status.description: Optional. Tracks promotion of a recommendation from proposed to implemented. Does not describe supersession — see 'supersedes'. Records predating this field have no status; this is expected and not a validation failure.

sentinel_ack.description: Acknowledgements for findings the infosec-sentinel validator flagged. Per-finding shape enforced by validate-infosec, not this schema.
